source_function.description: Source Function: onRequest(request, settings) handler for webhook ingestion (E-015)

destination_function.description: Destination Function: All 8 typed event handlers - onTrack, onIdentify, onGroup, onPage, onScreen, onAlias, onDelete, onBatch (E-016)
